entries.evidenceSource: Direct live application via `supabase db query --linked --file supabase/migrations/68_submissions_review_status.sql` against project gdumksfffewpdqqwvcdo, per explicit authorization scoped to this migration only (freeze lifted narrowly for this deployment window). Preflight confirmed `review_status` did not already exist on `submissions` and recorded a baseline row count of 31. Post-apply structural verification: `information_schema.columns` confirms `review_status` is `text`, `is_nullable='NO'`, `column_default = 'submitted'::text`; `pg_get_constraintdef` confirms the CHECK constraint `submissions_review_status_check` is exactly `CHECK ((review_status = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'reviewed'::text])))`; a full-table aggregate confirmed total=31 (row count unchanged from baseline), submitted_count=31, reviewed_count=0, null_count=0 — every pre-existing row backfilled correctly. Behavioral verification (rollback-safe, no meaningful production submission permanently modified): an UPDATE setting review_status='bogus' on a real row failed with Postgres error 23514 naming this exact constraint; a subsequent UPDATE setting review_status='reviewed' on a real row succeeded inside an explicit transaction, was rolled back, and independently re-confirmed reverted to 'submitted' via a fresh SELECT afterward.
entries.note: Applied via direct SQL execution (`db query --linked --file`), not `db push`/migration ledger reconciliation, same discipline as 66/67.
